proposed_edit.new_declaration:
/--
Variant of `Real.posLog_sum` for norms of elements in normed additive commutative
groups, using monotonicity of `log⁺` and the triangle inequality.
-/
lemma posLog_norm_sum_le {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → E) :
    log⁺ ‖∑ t ∈ s, f t‖ ≤ log s.card + ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ ‖f t‖ := by
  calc log⁺ ‖∑ t ∈ s, f t‖
  _ ≤ log⁺ (∑ t ∈ s, ‖f t‖) := by
    apply monotoneOn_posLog (by simp) _ (norm_sum_le s f)
    simp [Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ norm_nonneg (f i))]
  _ ≤ log s.card + ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ ‖f t‖ :=
    posLog_sum s (‖f ·‖)

lemma posLog_norm_sum_le {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → E) :
    log⁺ ‖∑ t ∈ s, f t‖ ≤ log s.card + ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ ‖f t‖ := by
  calc
    log⁺ ‖∑ t ∈ s, f t‖ ≤ log⁺ (∑ t ∈ s, ‖f t‖) := by
      refine (Real.monotoneOn_posLog ?_ ?_ (norm_sum_le s f))
      · simp
      · simp [Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => norm_nonneg (f i))]
    _ ≤ log s.card + ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ ‖f t‖ := by
      simpa using (Real.posLog_sum s (fun t => ‖f t‖))

    log⁺ (a ^ n) = n * log⁺ a := by

  simp [posLog_eq_log hpow.le, posLog_eq_log ha.le]
